spec.nulls_share: d5pp/d10pp absolute share points; rel10 = 10% of treated-pre mean

T3c_post_months.note: counts adoption month through last observed month (the last month, 2026-09, is partial)

T3d_ppml.inference: CR1 repo-clustered sandwich, G/(G-1); one-sided t(G-1) vs log(0.9); no WCR for PPML

T3b_loo_no_decline10.rule: for each excluded treated repo, worst one-sided WCR p over the 6 specs; then max over the 17 exclusions
